text.en: Pet owners consistently praise Daisy and her salon team for their gentle patience and warm customer care on Stoke Newington Church Street. Reviewers note that staff offer practical coat maintenance advice and communicate clearly throughout appointments. First-time visitors and longtime regulars describe feeling completely reassured leaving their pets in safe hands.

Clients report excellent styling results across various breeds, including miniature schnauzers and cavapoochons. Reviews highlight precision scissoring, thorough de-shedding, fluffy tail blow-outs, and gentle ultrasound teeth cleaning. Dog owners remark that their pets leave looking tidy, smelling fresh, and sporting evenly finished coats after full grooms.

Owners of nervous or grooming-sensitive dogs appreciate the calming atmosphere and affectionate care provided during salon visits. Clients highlight that Daisy takes extra time to soothe young puppies and anxious rescues before handling tools. Pet parents frequently express confidence knowing their dogs are treated with genuine warmth and patience.

q.en: Does Daisy's Dogs offer ultrasonic teeth cleaning?

a.en: Yes, clients mention bringing their dogs to the salon specifically for effective ultrasonic teeth cleaning sessions.

q.en: Do the groomers provide advice on home coat brushing?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that staff share helpful guidance on managing undercoats and preventing matting between appointments.

q.en: Can puppies receive their first groom at Daisy's Dogs?

a.en: Yes, pet parents report that young pups are welcomed with gentle introductory sessions tailored to build their confidence.

q.en: Where is Daisy's Dogs located in London?

a.en: The grooming boutique is located on Stoke Newington Church Street in North London.
